freeStart.title: Free rewards when you start
freeStart.where: New account → Squad · then My Club
freeStart.body: Before spending anything: creating an account already gives you 1 Common athlete in your Squad. Then create your club.
bullets: On signup the game grants 1 free Common (FT) athlete
Find them under My Club → Squad — ready to field
No club yet? Open My Club, type a name and click CREATE CLUB
Only after the club can you use Locker Room, Daily Presence and Sponsorships

lineup.title: Field your free athlete
lineup.body: Put your starter athlete on the pitch. On-field overwall drives earnings — no GMT required.
bullets: Open Locker Room under My Club
Drag or tap the free athlete into a pitch slot
Save with SAVE LINEUP (or wait for auto-save)
Use REST once per day (UTC) to refill squad stamina for free

checkin.title: Daily Presence (free every day)
checkin.body: Check in every day: +100 overwall for 7 days. After 7 days in a row you get 1 temporary player.
bullets: Open Daily Presence (also from the My Club hub card)
Click ✅ Check in today — once per day (UTC)
Each check-in grants +100 OW for 7 days (stacks up to 700 OW)
Complete 7 days in a row for 1 temporary player (streak). Miss a day and the streak resets

patrocinios.title: Sponsorships: automatic earnings
patrocinios.body: With an athlete on the pitch + presence bonus, Sponsorships credit on their own. You can earn before minting.
bullets: Confirm lineup in the Locker Room and that you checked in
Open Sponsorships under Economy
Watch on-field overwall (lineup + presence bonus)
Credits arrive automatically — no need to click to “mine”

wallet.title: Want to speed up? Use the Wallet
wallet.body: The free path already works. When you want more athletes or staff, deposit and swap to GMT.
bullets: Open Wallet under Economy
On the DEPOSIT tab, deposit USDC (Polygon)
On SWAP, exchange USDC → GMT (SWAP NOW)
Check GMT before spending in Scout or Office

scout.title: Scout: recruit with GMT
scout.body: With GMT you mint more NFT athletes to raise team overwall.
bullets: Open Scout (Market) or SCOUT on the hub
Click MINT — cost comes from GMT
New athletes show under My Club → Squad

office.title: Hire the Coach
office.body: Without a Coach the bench barely recovers stamina. Hire in the Office when you have balance.
bullets: Open Office under My Club (not on the hub grid)
On the COACH card, click HIRE
● HIRED means staff is active
Also check My Club → Training Center

economy.title: USDC, GMT and USDT
economy.body: From August 1st the economy works like this:
bullets: Deposits: USDC in Wallet
Internal economy (mint, staff, etc.): GMT
Sponsorships / mining and withdrawals: USDT
Always check Wallet balances and history

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.body: Share your link: when someone signs up with it, you can earn a referral reward (e.g. a temporary player).
bullets: Open Referrals under Economy
Copy your link or code and send it to friends
Each valid referral counts toward your progress
Pairs with presence and lineup — it does not replace daily check-in

ready.title: Day-1 checklist
ready.body: Recommended order: earn free first, then accelerate:
bullets: Account (free athlete) → create club → field in Locker Room
Daily Presence every day (+ streak → temp player)
Check Sponsorships (automatic earnings)
When ready: Wallet → Scout → Coach in Office
